en: Colorized historical postcard showing a long colonnaded building with arches and a raised gallery accessed by staircases. There is a classical-style statue in the foreground and people standing near the stairs. The structure is labeled as the Palais de Faïences in Stamboul (Istanbul), Constantinople. Handwritten purple ink appears at the top, and printed publisher/photographer information appears at the bottom.
